remediation.apply_accounting_profile: Apply an accounting profile to the company in Settings → Accounting.
remediation.import_chart_template: Import a chart of accounts template in Accounting Plan → Accounts.
remediation.fix_hierarchy: Review accounts with a missing parent and reassign their hierarchy.
remediation.fix_duplicate_codes: Rename duplicate codes: the code must be unique per company.
remediation.configure_mappings: Define accounting mappings per operation (sale, purchase, cash, payroll).
remediation.configure_posting_rules: Review and activate the posting rules of the accounting profile.
remediation.create_fiscal_year: Create the current fiscal year and generate its 12 periods.
remediation.close_accounting_period: Close past periods to lock the accounting information.
remediation.reverse_and_repost: Fix through a traceable reversal and post the operation again.
remediation.fix_account_flags: Mark the used accounts as postable and active, or reassign the lines.
remediation.contact_support: Structural issue: requires technical review before operating.
remediation.set_exchange_rate: Register the currency exchange rate in Settings → Currencies.
remediation.repost_sales: Post the affected sales again from the sale detail.
remediation.repost_payroll: Pay the payroll again to generate its journal entry.
remediation.review_sales: Review the flagged sales: totals, taxes and lines.
remediation.close_shift_z: Run the Z closing for closed shifts without an entry.
remediation.review_shifts: Review cash variances per shift and their justification.
remediation.review_receivables: Review customer credit and authorized limits.
remediation.adjust_stock: Fix negative stock with a count or inventory adjustment.
remediation.replenish_stock: Create purchase orders for products below minimum.
remediation.configure_fiscal_rules: Configure the country fiscal rules in Settings → Tax.
remediation.submit_declarations: Complete and submit the pending tax declarations.
remediation.map_bank_accounts: Link each bank account to its accounting account.
